design_principles: Clinical precision instrument, not a software product
Data density with pristine structural clarity

primary.usage: All system labels, navigation, KPI values, metadata, timers, score values, table headers.

secondary.usage: Finding titles, body descriptions, long-form text blocks.

styling_rules.borders: border-[0.5px] border-[#1A1A1A] for standard structural borders. border-[0.5px] border-[#2A2A2A] for strong dividers.
styling_rules.shadows: shadow-none. Rely entirely on background contrast and 0.5px borders for depth.
styling_rules.contrast: Extremely high contrast. Pure black and strict monochrome layers.
styling_rules.hover_states: Hover states should utilize Surface 2 (#0D0D0D) or solid pure white (#FFF) text inversions, keeping the sharp, technical aesthetic.

assets_and_media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (e.g. @phosphor-icons/react). Technical, sharp, minimal.
assets_and_media.images: Zero decoration. DO NOT generate or place any placeholder images, photos, or illustrations. The interface must remain entirely text, shapes, and data.

google_auth.description: Dark, severe minimalist login screen. 'Authenticate via Google' button with 0.5px border and no shadow. Terminal-like prompt feel.

workspace_dashboard.description: Dark, minimal dashboard acting as the command center. Contains the 'New Audit' trigger.

new_audit_drawer.description: Triggered by 'New Audit'. Contains Client Name, NACE Rev. 2 code (Searchable Dropdown), and Reporting Year.

intake_zone.description: The Black Box Intake. Drag-and-drop upload zone for PDF, XLSX, and TXT.
intake_zone.interaction: On drop, the zone MUST collapse into a 32px height status bar reading 'RECEIVING INPUT...' in Roboto Mono.

processing_state.description: Full-width panel that slides up with 5 sequential step indicators.
processing_state.extras: Live UTC timer (MM:SS) fixed in the top-right corner.

the_reveal.description: Post-processing dashboard reveal with a 300ms opacity transition.
the_reveal.score_animation: Main Compliance Score (0-100) must be a ring that animates from 0 to the final value over 800ms.

metrics: Greenwashing Risk Level (HIGH / MODERATE / LOW / NONE)

interactive_findings_table.layout: Clinical table sorted by severity, rows must be expandable.
interactive_findings_table.visuals: Severity tags must be 0.5px outlined tags matching semantic colors (Red, Amber, Green). Use MISSING/UNVERIFIED visual tags.

strategic_value_roadmap.format: 'Action -> Metric Impact -> € Saving'. Must include implementation cost and payback months.

re_score_simulator.description: Interactive panel where users mark findings as 'Resolved' to see their projected compliance score update in real-time.

pdf_export.description: PDF Delivery / Download action. Keep it as a sharp, text-focused command button.

technical_instructions.components: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for macro layouts. Use Shadcn for complex logic (Tables, Drawers, Dropdowns, Select), heavily customizing them to strip out ALL border-radius and shadows.
technical_instructions.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='new-audit-button', data-testid='compliance-score'). Use kebab-case and role-based naming.
technical_instructions.grids: Rely strictly on CSS grids with 0.5px borders acting as strict dividing lines between cells and zones. No floating cards.
